method: Exact original PNG byte copy, no pixel edits. Six alpha-bounded cuts measured from the native output; alpha > 8 with two pixels of transparent gutter. Runtime repeats wall cap segments clipped to the real wall geometry.
prompt: Create one ORIGINAL transparent PNG sprite atlas for DEADWALL, a serious grounded post-collapse French town viewed in a strictly ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP-DOWN 2D game. Canvas landscape 1536x1024. Exactly SIX isolated assets, organised as 3 equal columns by 2 rows. Absolutely transparent background everywhere between assets, generous clear gutters at least 55 pixels, no touching assets, NO labels, NO text, NO icons, NO arrows, NO diagrams, NO base tiles, NO perspective or isometric view. Top row: three distinct straight stair flights seen exactly from directly above, long axis VERTICAL and all rising towards TOP of image, same physical rectangular footprint width-to-height 2.1:2.9, each flight fills about 300x414 pixels inside its cell; narrow side railing visible within its physical rectangle, eight to ten rectangular horizontal treads, narrow lower landing, believable shadows inside the flight only. Top left old timber staircase with worn brown wooden steps and thin dark rail, top middle utilitarian dark oxidised steel staircase with muted grey tread plates and thin steel rail, top right old cast-concrete staircase with dusty chipped grey concrete treads and a narrow worn plaster side. NO people, NO huge structural superstructure, NO door, NO furniture, NO shadows extending beyond the rectangular staircase. Bottom row: three long horizontal structural WALL TOP-CAP segments, seen strictly vertically from above, each about 400x70 pixels, six-to-one aspect ratio, each a rectangular continuous wall cap suitable to repeat along an existing thin collision wall, full rectangular opaque interior and tiny natural edge chips. Bottom left worn pale warm grey plaster masonry wall cap with subtle dust and hairline paint crack; bottom middle aged muted terracotta brick masonry wall cap showing coarse perpendicular brick joints and mortar; bottom right cast-concrete wall cap with fine dark porous grey aggregate and chips. Edges stay straight and architectural, NO holes through their interiors, no side elevations, no vertical building faces, no ground behind the wall caps, no plants. Palette low saturation concrete ash, rust, umber, dirty plaster. Painterly realistic game sprite texture with immediately readable step rhythm and wall surfaces at 32 pixels per metre. Deliver native transparent alpha suitable to crop each of the six original individual drawings with clear gutters.
